title_zh: 选定罢工期间可直达机场的巴士

scenario.label_zh: 选定罢工期间可直达机场的巴士
scenario.goal_zh: 核对机场巴士的当日停靠点和行李限制，并选定不在郊区停靠的直达班次

context_zh: 虚构交通咨询：旅客在铁路罢工日询问巴士，所有班次信息只属于对话情境。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: With the rail strike today, can I take your nine o'clock bus to the airport?

sentences.speaker: Ticket Clerk Sam
sentences.text: Yes. That service is running and goes directly to terminal two.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Does it stop in the suburb of Belton? My sister lives there.

sentences.speaker: Ticket Clerk Sam
sentences.text: No. It's strictly an airport service today. The town bus still serves Belton, but it doesn't go to the airport.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Then I'll visit her another day. Is one suitcase and a small backpack all right?

sentences.speaker: Ticket Clerk Sam
sentences.text: Yes. We have a strict one-suitcase limit per passenger, plus one small bag you can keep with you.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: That works. I'll take the nine o'clock airport bus.

sentences.speaker: Ticket Clerk Sam
sentences.text: Board at bay six. Tickets are sold at the machine beside the bay.
